mcqs.question: Why treat maintenance as a public-interest concern?

options.text: A service is useful only while someone can repair it. Reliability depends on ordinary care, not a dramatic launch.
I ask someone new to perform a routine task from the notes. Every private explanation marks knowledge the service has not retained.
I would place short operational notes beside each recurring task. A real handoff will test whether those notes are enough.

mcqs.rationale: The correct option reproduces the answer to this held-out question; the alternatives come from related answers or reverse its intent.
